text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Citizens robbed of 30 million German marks in financial scandals in several private banks.
- Domestic airline has less work than before, planes flying with 52 percent capacity.
- Export of 1,750 tonnes of high quality Macedonian lamb uncertain. Exports to EU countries forbidden because of foot-and-mouth disease that hit Macedonia last summer.
- Macedonia and Tanzania establish diplomatic relations.
- Macedonia and Turkey discuss concluding social security convention.
- Ethnic Albanian deputies threaten to leave parliament if the Albanian language is not included as second language in the work of the Macedonian parlaiment.

- Protest marches of workers from Makedonka textile industry from Stip start today in this eastern Macedonian town. Over 3,000 workers ask for work and demand several outstanding salaries from last year.
